item.text: I’ll inspect the analytics module and its tests, record an early checkpoint, then implement the privacy and initialization behavior and run the relevant local tests.

The source uses the old boolean `init` argument, and I found no other source callers of the analytics methods. I’ll preserve that argument for compatibility while adding enum based anonymity state. I’ll also update the tests that expect DNT to block initialization or rely on unawaited `init()`.
